string.text:
A field medic might call it luck, if they had not seen your old wounds. Your body has learned to respond to artefact pulses, making them part of recovery after a patrol as well as protection during it.
 
%c[ui_gray_3]EFFECTS:
 %c[d_blue] - %c[ui_gray_2]Healing artefacts on the belt restore permanent health to all 6 BHS body parts.
 %c[d_blue] - %c[ui_gray_2]Each damaged body part receives +1 HP per cycle, capped at its own maximum.
 %c[d_blue] - %c[ui_gray_2]Cycle time: 75 seconds / total healing strength. Ordinary artefact strength uses health_restore_speed x 1000.
 %c[d_blue] - %c[ui_gray_2]Artefact condition scales its contribution; multiple sources add together.
 %c[d_blue] - %c[ui_gray_2]Within 5 m of a lit campfire, total healing speed doubles.
 %c[ui_gray_3]PBA PERK ARTEFACTS (strength before the general campfire bonus):
 %c[ui_gray_2]Signet: 0.4 near a lit campfire. Sun: 0.58 from 05:00 through 21:00, outdoors in clear weather. Moon: 0.35 at night. Chain: 1 for Sin, 0.25 otherwise. Heart: 0.8 below its PBA health threshold. Lucifer: 3 on the belt or 1 in inventory, never counted twice. All contributions scale with condition.
 
 %c[d_red]REQUIRES A COMPATIBLE BODY HEALTH SYSTEM. SPECIAL PERK ARTEFACTS REQUIRE PBA / GAMMA ARTEFACTS REINVENTION.%c[ui_gray_2]
 The standalone Artefact Limb Healing mod is not required. No healing is enabled before purchasing this perk.
